headline: Google has started testing ads inside AI Mode for people who have turned on its Personal Intelligence feature.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: only the headline could be read, so the scope and details of the test are unverified.
importance_line: People who use Google's AI Mode with Personal Intelligence switched on may now see ads in their answers, and advertisers gain a new place to reach them, but how personal data is used for these ads is not yet clear.
summary: Search Engine Land reports that Google has begun testing ads in AI Mode, its AI-driven search mode, for users who have enabled a feature called Personal Intelligence.
notes: Search Engine Land page blocked (HTTP 403). Three Google News searches found no other outlet with the story, so the entry is headline only. v1_category changed from MOD to MKT: advertising business.
